title: Human Resource Management: Building Your Dream Team

mc.q: The first three activities of the human resource management (HRM) process are about ________.
Of the choices given, the most accurate description of the human resource management is that it is concerned with ________ competent employees.
For the most part, ________ are involved in HR decisions within their own department or unit.
Employment planning involves ________.
o: addition of staff and reduction of staff only
addition of staff, reduction of staff, and selection only
addition of staff, reduction of staff, motivation of staff, and selection

mc.q: Which one of the following is the goal of employment planning?
o: obtaining competent employees with up-to-date skills

mc.q: The last steps of the HRM process deal with ________.
The most important environmental factor in the HRM process is ________.
________ prohibits discrimination based on race, color, religion, national origin, or sex.
o: Title VII of the Civil Rights Act

mc.q: A wheelchair-bound applicant may be denied a job ________.
o: if the job is strenuous or physically tiring in some way
if the job requires complete physical mobility
mc.note: On the sheet B is also marked, C is circled. Under the Americans with Disabilities Act an applicant can only be rejected if the disability prevents performing essential job functions – e.g. a job requiring complete physical mobility.

mc.q: Affirmative action programs seek to make sure that employers ________ minority groups.
Which U.S. law gives you the legal right to see your professor's letter of recommendation?
mc.note: On the sheet D is also circled. The Privacy Act of 1974 gives employees (and students) the right to examine letters of reference about them.

mc.q: In setting up interviews for an executive position, Francesca makes sure to include candidates of different ethnic backgrounds, including individuals from protected minority groups. Which kind of program is she attempting to carry out?
mc.note: On the sheet B is also marked, D is circled. Programs that enhance employment opportunities for protected groups = affirmative action.

mc.q: Prior to setting up the interviews for the executive position, Francesca spent a great deal of time analyzing the position and determining what skills, attitudes, and actions it would require. This lengthy review is called a ________.
mc.note: On the sheet B is also marked, D is circled. The lengthy assessment of a job and the behaviors needed to perform it = job analysis.

mc.q: The first step in any employment planning process involves making a ________.
The lengthy process by which a job is examined in detail in order to identify the skills, knowledge and behaviors necessary to perform the job is known as a ________.

As one of his first tasks in a new job, Steve's boss asks him to develop a database that lists the educational level, special capabilities, and specialized skills of all the employees in his firm. This is known as a ________.
A job description is ________.
o: a written document used to describe a job to job candidates
something that employers keep secret from job candidates
the official title for the job

mc.q: A job specification is ________.
o: a detailed description of the job
the description of a job that is used by an employment agency

mc.q: HR managers can accurately estimate human resource needs for an organization by evaluating which one of the following?
o: the general state of the economy

mc.q: A written statement of what a job holder does in his or her job, how it is done, and why it is done is known as a ________.
Downsizing seems to harm ________.
o: both victims who are dismissed and survivors who stayed on
managers who carried out the dismissals and their families only

mc.q: To improve workplace diversity, a manager might ________.
o: post a notice that states he is an equal opportunity employer

mc.q: According to the EEOC, sexual harassment is ________ that creates a hostile environment, interferes with a person's work or diminishes the person's employment opportunities.
o: any unwanted or unsolicited speech or physical conduct
any speech of a sexual nature
any speech or physical conduct of a sexual nature
mc.note: B is circled, D is also slightly marked on the sheet. The textbook definition stresses that the conduct is UNWANTED/unsolicited; please double-check with your instructor.

mc.q: ________ are filed with the EEOC each year.
o: More sexual harassment complaints from males than females
More sexual harassment complaints from females than males
About an equal number of sexual harassment complaints from males and females
Almost no sexual harassment complaints from males

mc.q: If an employee rebuffs inappropriate sexual advances from her boss but still receives a promotion, ________.
o: the boss can't be guilty of sexual harassment
the employee is not allowed to lodge a complaint
the boss can still be guilty of sexual harassment
the employee is not allowed to lodge a complaint if she accepts the promotion

mc.q: The key to most sexual harassment cases against an organization is whether the organization ________.
o: knew about the behavior and what it did to stop it
told other employees in the department that harassment occurred
fired the employee after the charges were lodged
had hired a known sex offender

mc.q: What financial threat does sexual harassment pose to companies?
o: enormous risk of major lawsuit settlements
none, because companies are insured against harassment

mc.q: Who would usually hear an appeal if an employee felt he or she had been inappropriately accused of sexual harassment?
o: a manager at a higher level not associated with the case
a manager at a higher level who is already involved in the case
mc.note: On the sheet B is also marked, C is circled. Appeals should be heard by a higher-level manager who is not associated with the case.

mc.q: Which one of the following would be considered grounds for a sexual harassment charge?
o: jokes that had a sexual theme but no one found offensive
artwork that, while some considered classic, made some employees feel uncomfortable
hiring a male employee who had been previously convicted of a sex crime
consensual dating between an employee and supervisor

mc.q: Part-time, temporary, and contract workers who are available for hire on an as-needed basis are known as ________.
Which one of the following is commonly considered a category of workforce diversity?
Which one of the following would be most likely to be true of two random people of the same race?
o: They are likely to have very different skin color and hair type.
They are unlikely to speak the same language.
They are likely to have similar skin color and hair type.
They are likely to share the same cultural traditions.

mc.q: In addition to prohibiting age discrimination, what else does the Age Discrimination Act do?
o: Sets the mandatory age for receiving Social Security benefits.
Allows for early retirement for age related causes of poor performance.
Restricts mandatory retirement at specific ages.
Created the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission.

mc.q: Which kind of discrimination is NOT prohibited under federal law?
o: discrimination against people from the Middle East

mc.q: Which problems are women LEAST likely to face in today's workplace?
o: skepticism about whether they are qualified to do the job

mc.q: Which one of the following countries' laws pertaining to HRM practices is most closely parallel to those in the United States?
________ in Germany give(s) employees the right to participate in personnel decisions.
mc.note: On the sheet C is also marked, D is circled. German work councils (Betriebsräte) give employees co-determination rights in personnel decisions; board representatives sit on the supervisory board.

mc.q: In global companies, a major cause of the line between work and non-work getting blurred is ________.
o: employees needing to commute long distances
needing to communicate with overseas operations in different time zones
needing to communicate on a face-to-face basis with employees
employees needing to work on holidays

mc.q: To find out more about a job with a title of "assistant media buyer," you would find this to be most helpful.
Which one of the following is the goal of employment planning?
o: obtaining competent employees with up-to-date skills
mc.note: Same question as Q5. On the sheet A and C are both circled here; A is consistent with Q5 (employment planning ensures competent employees are identified and selected).

scenarios.The New Hire: Francesca begins her career working in the human resources department of a major corporation. She is asked to help ensure the organization is following the federal guidelines for employment.

open: In a short essay, discuss why sexual harassment is such a difficult problem in today's workplace.
In a short essay, discuss how workforce diversity is directly affected by recruitment, selection, orientation, and training.
